QuestInfo.name: [Cygnus Knights] Gathering Intel
QuestInfo.0: 10 Boogies has come up with a new plan to investigate the Puppeteer. Listen in.
QuestInfo.1:
Look for new intel by analyzing the Patrol Robots' memory chips. Defeat the #bPatrol Robot S#k models
at the #bRoad to the Mine 1#k to get their Memory
Chips. Then go defeat #bSafety First#k robots at the #bRoad to the Mine 2#k to collect the batteries
required for the analysis.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered the components needed and delivered them to 10 Boogies.

default.0: Ah, I think we need more components. Hunt the #bPatrol Robot S#k models for #bPatrol Robot S's Memory Chips#k, and hunt the #bSafety First#k robots for 20 #bWorking Rue Batteries#k.\r\n
